capabilities: Number and renumber headings with configurable outline numbers, styles and templates
Rewrite wikilinks, Markdown links and embeds to renumbered headings across the vault
Show numbers on screen without writing them into the note
Insert a live table of contents block that redraws as headings change
Apply per-note properties and per-folder numbering rules
extras: Freemium: an optional paid companion, Section Numbering Pro (one-time payment, 14-day trial), adds numbering profiles, cross-note cross-references, figure/table numbers and HTML/Pandoc/LaTeX export; all features described in the README stay free. No network access.
intentEvidence: Notes numbered by the original Number Headings plugin are picked up and renumbered in place.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in outline numbering for headings, and adding numbers by hand breaks heading links and goes stale when sections are reordered.

relations.evidence: Notes numbered by the original Number Headings plugin are picked up and renumbered in place.

summary: Heading numbering plugin that writes outline numbers (1, 1.1) into headings, renumbers them when sections move, and rewrites heading links.
